```{r score PANAS}
# Code script to score the Positive and Negative Affect  - Watson et al. (1988)
#  https://doi.org/10.1037/0022-3514.54.6.1063
# Scoring instructions: The even items correspond to negative affect and the odd items correspond to positive affect. The raw scores on the negative items are summed to obtain a total raw score that ranges from 5 to 25. The raw scores on the positive items are summed to obtain a total raw score that ranges from 5 to 25. 

# Load required packages
library(dplyr)
library (readr)

# Load data
PANAS <- read_tsv("/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/separate_tsvs/panas.tsv")

# Compute total scores for each individual participant
PANAS <- PANAS %>%
  mutate(
    panas_sum_pos = rowSums(select(., panas_1, panas_3, panas_5, panas_7, panas_9), na.rm = TRUE),
    panas_sum_neg = rowSums(select(., panas_2, panas_4, panas_6, panas_8, panas_10), na.rm = TRUE),
  )%>%
  rename_with(tolower) # lowercase 
write_tsv(PANAS,"/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/final_scored_tsvs/panas.tsv", na = "n/a")
```
``` {r PANAS distribution}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

PANAS %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = panas_sum_pos)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "PANAS Positive Affect total (5–25)", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of PANAS Positive Affect scores")

PANAS %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = panas_sum_neg)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "PANAS Negative Affect total (5–25)", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of PANAS Negative Affect scores")

```
